question: Does prior strong-chorus history of the focal species at a physical SiteID predict wet-survey strong chorus beyond the SiteID's general acoustic productivity and prior sampling opportunity?
population: Physically stable matched pairs. Focal species are route-new in the wetter survey, absent from the entire paired dry route, and recorded somewhere in the same route-season stratum strictly before the focal pair.
unit: pair x focal species x physical SiteID
prior_information: Only eligible runs in the same State x RouteNumber x RunNumber stratum strictly before the earlier focal-pair year.

predictors.focal_prior_site_strong: 1 if the focal species had CallingIndex 2-3 at this SiteID in any prior eligible run.
predictors.prior_site_exposure: Number of prior eligible runs in which this exact SiteID was sampled.
predictors.general_strong_richness: Mean number of OTHER species at CallingIndex 2-3 per prior run in which this SiteID was sampled.
predictors.general_any_richness: Mean number of OTHER calling species (CallingIndex 1-3) per prior run in which this SiteID was sampled; secondary control.

row_eligibility: Require prior_site_exposure >=1. Primary pair x species groups must contain both focal_prior_site_strong=1 and 0 SiteIDs after this restriction.

outcomes.primary: wet_strong = 1 if focal wet CallingIndex is 2 or 3.

primary_design: Demean outcome, focal memory, log1p(prior_site_exposure), and general_strong_richness exactly within pair x species. OLS without intercept; cluster covariance by State x RouteNumber.
primary_prediction: Focal-species memory coefficient >0 with complete 95% CI >0 after controlling site exposure and general strong-chorus richness.
secondary: Replace/add general strong richness with general any-caller richness.
minimum_gate: >=500 informative pair x species groups, >=250 routes, >=20 species before outcome readback.
interpretation: Support indicates species-specific local recurrence beyond generic acoustically productive sites and prior observation effort.
It still cannot separate persistent habitat matching from local population recurrence or other stable species x site associations.
No individual site fidelity, continuous occupancy, reproductive success, biological memory or causal rainfall claim is authorized.
